blocks.text: Hadhrat Umar (RA), "why do we have to submit?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said to him, "O person! He is certainly the Rasool of Allaah. He cannot disobey Allaah and Allaah is his Helper." Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "Did Rasulullaah ﷺ not tell us that we shall arrive at the Kabah and perform Tawaaf around it?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "He did indeed, but did he tell you that it would be this year?" "No," said Hadhrat Umar (RA). "Then you shall certainly arrive there and perform Tawaaf around it," Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) assured him. After narrating this incident, Hadhrat Umar (RA) says that he later carried out numerous good deeds to make amends for this behaviour.
The Happiness of Rasulullaah ﷺ when Revelation About Forgiveness and Victory Arrived as they were Returning from Hudaybiyyah
Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that as Rasulullaah ﷺ was returning from Hudaybiyyah, Allaah revealed the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللّٰهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ
blocks.text: So that Allaah may forgive you (O Rasulullaah ﷺ) for your past shortcomings and those that may occur in the future. {Surah Fatah, verse 2}

Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "Such a verse was revealed to me tonight that I love more than everything on earth." When Rasulullaah ﷺ recited the verse to the Sahabah (RA), they said, "Congratulations to you, O Nabi of Allaah ﷺ. Allaah has made it clear how He will be treating you, but what about us?" It was then that the following verse was revealed:

blocks.arabic_text: لِّيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّاٰتِهِمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيْمًا
blocks.text: So that Allaah may admit the Mu'mineen men and women into Jannaat beneath which rivers flow. They will live there forever and He shall (also) pardon them for their sins. This is the great success in Allaah's sight. {Surah Fatah, verse 5}[^1]
Hadhrat Anas (RA) reports that after Rasulullaah ﷺ had been prevented from performing Umrah, he was returning from Hudaybiyyah when the following verse was revealed:
Indeed, We have granted you (O Rasulullaah ﷺ) a clear victory[^2]. {Surah Fatah, verse 1}
When Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) slaughtered their sacrificial animals at Hudaybiyyah, they were filled with grief and sorrow. Rasulullaah ﷺ
Ahmad. Bukhaari and Muslim have reported a similar narration, as quoted in Tafseer of Ibn Katheer (Vol.4 Pg.183).
Allaah granted the victory through the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah because after this treaty large numbers of people accepted Islaam and it led to the conquest of Makkah.
